sources.title: MOSS-Music-8B-Thinking - a Hugging Face Space by hugging-apps
sources.snippet: An open-source music understanding model (~9.1B params) from the OpenMOSS team. Upload a music clip and ask about its mood, genre, instrumentation, lyrics, chords, tempo, structure, and more. The Thinking variant provides chain-of-thought musical analysis.

sources.title: MOSS-Music-8B (Instruct + Thinking) — Models — The AI Bench
sources.snippet: Thinking variant adds chain-of-thought reasoning over audio. When not to use: You want music GENERATION — this is understanding-only (audio in, text out). For text-to-music try Suno / Udio (hosted) or Stable Audio (open-weight, separate model). And it's English-leaning on lyrics ASR; non-Latin script lyrics may suffer.
